ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) ratio approximately 1:4 on the visible ventral surface of the left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black background on the lateral margin; light grey vertical striations extending from the trailing edge towards the base on the medial-to-central region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; visible angle approximately 40-50 degrees, vertex is partially occluded by water splash displacement.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude irregular serration on the left lobe with approximately 6-8 distinct peaks; right lobe trailing edge appears smoother or partially occluded by water surface and angle of view.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a strong convex sweep on the leading edge tapering to a sharp, narrow tip; trailing edge follows a jagged diagonal trajectory toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Three distinct, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters arranged linearly on the dark leading edge of the distal left fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of light grey vertical rake-like streaks visible against the dark ventral pigmentation of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular white scarring on the leading edge of the left fluke; significant irregular loss of tissue/deep serrations on the trailing edge of the left lobe compared to standard smooth contours.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced elongation and tapering of the left fluke tip relative to the visible body of the fluke.
